title: envelope
description: One factory event: the fields every event has, with its payload in data. One line in the local event log, one row in the factory database.

envelope.description: The version of this envelope. A reader refuses one it does not know.

event_id.description: A UUID the writer makes. The event's identity: a re-push or a retried insert never makes a second row.

ts.description: When the event was written: UTC, ISO 8601, always with exactly three millisecond digits (2026-10-16T15:45:19.123Z), so times sort and compare as text.

type.description: The event type, for example claimed or transition. Names the payload's schema with type_version.

type_version.description: The version of this type's payload. data is valid against schemas/<type>.v<type_version>.json.

repo.description: The repository whose factory wrote it, as owner/name.

device.description: The machine that wrote it: DEV_MACHINE_NAME, else the hostname.

actor.description: The tool or role that wrote it, for example sweep, watcher, fixer or factory-reconcile; agent when the caller named none. For provenance only: what a reader needs to know is in the type and the payload.

session_id.description: The Claude session that wrote it, from CLAUDE_SESSION_ID, else CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (Claude Code sets it); null when both are unset. Never guessed.

issue.description: The GitHub issue the event is about; null for a fleet-level event. Each type's schema says whether it is required (x-issue).

base_image.description: The base image version running when it was written; null when unknown.

dev_image.description: The repo's dev image version running when it was written; null when unknown or none.

template_version.description: The Coder template version running when it was written; null when unknown.

plugin_version.description: The fabriek plugin version running when it was written; null when unknown.

regime.description: Which kind of run wrote it: factory_loop_v2 is work the v2 factory loop did, testbed is a testbed or experiment run, manual is a person or an interactive session. Optional: absent or null means unknown, never guessed. A reader filters by naming the values it wants.

data.description: The payload: a flat object whose fields the type's schema describes.
